Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the follow-ups I promised:

- Key decision criteria you mentioned: predictable latency under 200ms P95 for chat, SOC 2 evidence, and PO-based billing.
- Proposed deployment: Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) for your production pilot, with a private control plane for the initial integration.

Could you confirm the procurement flow so we can align timelines? Specifically:
1) Who is the economic buyer (final sign-off person / title)?
2) Who owns security/legal review vs. procurement/finance? Any required questionnaires or templates we should pre-fill?
3) Typical PO lead time once contract & SOW are agreed?

Attached is a short checklist that helps us map requirements (one pager). Happy to fill the questionnaire if you send it. Proposed next steps:
- Oliver: share stakeholder names & procurement contact (if different from Priya)
- Priya: share any procurement questionnaire or vendor onboarding link
- We (Rishi + me): prepare SOW draft and send Redwood W-9 for your finance team

If it helps, we can target a 3-week procurement runway from SOW final to PO issuance — is that realistic on your side?

Thanks,

Hi Marissa / team —

Thanks for the timeline and the questionnaire. A few procurement specifics to note:

- PO process: We require a fully executed SOW + completed vendor onboarding questionnaire + W-9 to generate a PO.
- Invoice terms: Net 30 via AP portal (we'll provide vendor portal link once onboarding is complete).
- Tax docs: W-9 required for domestic vendors; please include remit-to details on your invoice.
- Contract redlines: legal will send any redlines to your counsel; typical turnaround 5–7 business days.

If you can get the SOW + questionnaire + W-9 to us by 23 Mar, procurement will target PO issuance by 13 Apr (assuming legal review is standard). If any of the legal/security items escalate, timeline will shift.

Also: please upload SOW and documents to our secure intake form: https://procure.novabank.com/vendor-intake/nb-uploads

We'll expect the vendor questionnaire back by EoD 20 Mar. Thanks — looking forward to moving this to PO.
